note.kid: On a rented line between two routers, the parcel rides in a simple envelope. Each router opens it and puts the parcel in a fresh one for the next line.
note.nerd: Cisco HDLC on a leased line: a flag, address 0x0F, control 0x00, an EtherType and a 16-bit check. Each router ends the frame; keepalives every 10 seconds tell both ends the line is up.

flag.name: Flag
flag.about: Marks where a frame starts and ends in the stream of bits.

address.name: Address
address.about: 0x0F for an ordinary frame: a line has only two ends.

proto.about: What the frame carries, with Ethernet’s numbers: 0x0800 is an IPv4 packet.

fcs.name: FCS
fcs.about: A check over the frame, so a crackle on the line is noticed.
